editable.fuzz 188: `<hr>` directly inside a `<select>` (traced in 5.7: the body reduces to `<select><hr>`). Gumbo keeps the `<hr>` as a child of the select; AngleSharp's tree builder drops the start tag, so the editor value loses the `<hr>`. Class B, hostile-only fuzz body.
editable.fuzz 395: `</form>` inside a `<template>` (traced in 5.7: the body reduces to `<template><form><summary></form>text`). Gumbo's `</form>` closes the open `<summary>` with the form, AngleSharp's leaves it open, so the text after it stays inside the `<summary>` (and a `<video>` later in the body moves with it). Class B (b), hostile-only fuzz body.
